name: How long does a typical interior trim installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical interior trim installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an interior trim installation project varies based on the scope and complexity. For a single room with basic trim like baseboards and door casings, it might take 1-3 days. A whole-house trim upgrade, especially with custom profiles or intricate crown molding, could extend to 1-2 weeks. Factors like material availability, existing wall conditions, and the need for painting or staining after installation also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after our initial consultation and site assessment.
